'''TK-718''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] serving on [[Garos IV]] during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. TK-718 was part of the team that arrested [[Cord Barzon]].<ref name="Shadows of Darkness" />
